description: This Java class represents a 'Keyword' entity used in the admin module of the Spring-based web application. It encapsulates product-related keyword information with fields for product ID, language code, and keyword, including getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Keyword
classes.description: The Keyword class models a product keyword with associated language and product ID information for administrative purposes.

methods.name: setProductId
methods.description: Sets the product ID associated with the keyword.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Returns the product ID associated with the keyword.

methods.name: setLanguageCode
methods.description: Sets the language code for the keyword.

methods.name: getLanguageCode
methods.description: Returns the language code for the keyword.
